title: Chapter 695
text:
Sol Cluster, Klent Kingdom, a certain military planet.

On the surface, this was a military fortress planet used to maintain fleets and produce battleships, but in reality, this was the headquarters of Klent's Secret Strategy Department. The Secret Strategy Department was Klent's secret organization that carried out missions that could not be exposed.

Funding Dark-star and contacting the Fallen Ark were the jobs of the Secret Strategy Department.

The Secret Strategy Department had extremely high security clearance. The internal members of the organization could only be responsible for their own missions and could not access the information of other operations from the database. The garrison on this planet was not only a disguise but also a means to prevent the members of the Secret Strategy Department from betraying and leaking information.

The secret war was fully managed by the Bloodshed Land and did not take orders from Klent. Although Klent did not directly interfere in the war on the surface, in private, they carried out some secret operations behind the backs of the Bloodshed Land and influenced the secret war through the Secret Strategy Department.

Sending the Dark-star leader and EsGod's doppelganger to exile Black Star was an operation led by the Secret Strategy Department, and they thought it was a sure thing. However, when they received news that the Dark-star leader had gone missing, they were shocked and regretted it. They urgently called for a meeting to discuss how to deal with it.

"If the banishment operation fails, the worst-case scenario is that DarkStar will fall into Black Star's hands and expose our relationship with them. We have to eliminate all traces of our relationship with DarkStar immediately."

"Black Star might not be able to see the truth. We've already instructed the people of DarkStar that no matter what the circumstances are, they have to bear all the responsibility. Everything was done on his own accord, and no one ordered him to do so. He will not expose Klent. He knows the consequences."

"We can't be lucky. We have to be prepared for the worst. Black Star is very cautious and suspicious. He'll definitely have doubts about Dark-star and EsGod's doppelganger and connect it to us. Furthermore, it's not the first time he's framed us. Even if the Dark-star guy doesn't say anything, he can still make up a statement to frame us. I know him too well!"

"Yes, Black Star is very likely to do so. He has no integrity and is a dangerous person who will do anything. We must make the people in the Ministry of Foreign Affairs insist that this is slander. We must never admit that we have a working relationship with Dark-star and the Fallen Ark. This is a complete fabrication. We must never admit it."

At this time, a member added:

"There's another thing. Temporarily stop all plans to assassinate Black Star. The success rate is too low. Even EsGod's doppelganger couldn't finish him off. If no Beyond Grade A Super personally acts, I'm afraid we won't be able to finish off Black Star. Furthermore, after this battle, Black Star will definitely be more vigilant, so there won't be another chance."

Everyone quickly finalized the report and submitted it to the higher-ups. This attack plan was not worth the losses, and there was no point in regretting it. They could only do their best to salvage the situation and reduce the losses.

Who knew that even EsGod could not deal with Black Star!

…

Godora civilization's mother planet, government building.

The Supreme Leader, Serbia the Fifth, was working at his desk, reviewing documents one after another. This time, his private communicator received a call request and vibrated.

Serbia the Fifth glanced at it, and his eyes sparkled. It was a call from Black Star.

His private communicator was a highly encrypted and locked line. Only very important people could contact him directly, and Han Xiao was one of them.

"Your Excellency Black Star, what's the matter?" Serbia the Fifth went straight to the point. He was very busy every day, so he did not think that Black Star was calling just to chat with him.

"I've caught the Dark-star leader who escaped and am preparing to hand him over to you. However, I need to meet you personally," Han Xiao said.

Serbia the Fifth was stunned for a moment before standing up. "You caught him?"

The escaped Dark-star leader had always been his worry. He was worried every day that Dark-star would make a comeback. He did not expect Han Xiao to suddenly give him such a huge surprise.

…

More than ten days later, Han Xiao drove the spaceship back to the Black Star headquarters in the Garton Star System. Harrofal left halfway to report on the situation at the observatory.

At this time, the large dock of the Black Star headquarters was filled with people. Serbia the Fifth had been waiting with his guards for a long time. Beside him was the emissary of the Amethyst Civilization. Around them were countless galactic media reporters who were blocked by the guards, taking pictures non-stop. Even further away were the mercenaries who had heard the news and came to watch the show.

Many reporters were whispering to each other.

"Purple Crystal and Godora are welcoming Black Star together. What does this mean? Why did the higher-ups ask us to come and report? Is there some big news? "

"Who knows? I heard that this is an invitation from Purple Crystal. Although they did not say the reason, who would dare to reject it? There must be something to announce. We will not come here for nothing."

The galactic reporters present were all invited and did not know what they were going to report. However, with Purple Crystal's name, no one dared to reject it.

Furthermore, the location was at the headquarters of the Black Star Corps. Everyone felt that once Black Star was involved, it would definitely be big news worth reporting. Therefore, although they were kept in the dark, their enthusiasm was very high, and they were secretly curious about what the news was.

It was Han Xiao's request to gather the reporters. He was prepared to make the handover of the Dark-star leader into sensational news to increase his influence. After contacting Godora, he also contacted Purple Crystal.

Purple Crystal was shocked by the news of EsGod's doppelganger. Seeing that Han Xiao was fine, they were relieved.

After knowing what Han Xiao meant, Purple Crystal immediately agreed. They fully supported any plan to deal with Klent. Therefore, they took the initiative to invite the various galactic media to watch the handover ceremony of the Dark-star leader. However, they did not reveal it beforehand.

Han Xiao parked the spaceship at the dock. Everyone's eyes were focused on him, and they subconsciously held their breaths. It was as if they had pressed the freeze button, and the place became silent.

Under everyone's gazes, the hatch opened, and Han Xiao walked out. Only then did the clamor start again.

Serbia the Fifth and the emissary of the Amethyst Civilization quickly walked up and talked to Han Xiao. The galactic reporters started to record the whole process.

Brock mixed in the crowd and looked at Serbia the Fifth from time to time. As a spy of Dark-star, he did not have a good impression of the current highest leader of Godora. He suppressed his hatred and did not want others to find out.

Han Xiao chatted with Serbia the Fifth for a while. He glanced at the galactic reporters around him, smiled, and said, "Let's get down to business first."

He turned around and looked at the hatch. Two Oathkeepers appeared with the dejected Dark-star leader.

Everyone's eyes instantly fell on the Dark-star leader. Confusion, shock, and other emotions appeared in their eyes. Many people did not know the Dark-star leader.

This time, Serbia the Fifth opened his mouth and announced loudly, "This person is the Dark-star leader who has been on the run. Godora has put in a lot of effort, but we have not been able to catch this culprit. This time, thanks to His Excellency Black Star's help, we have captured this criminal. I thank you on behalf of Godora for your help!"

Then, he bowed slightly to Han Xiao.

As the highest leader of a civilization, he expressed his gratitude to Han Xiao on behalf of the entire civilization. This instantly shocked the crowd and caused an uproar!

"That's the Dark-star leader?"

"So, they are handing over this criminal today. No wonder we are here to report."

"Godora's leader actually came personally to hand over the handover. The Black Star Corps is so ostentatious!"

Serbia the Fifth continued, "The Dark-star organization has been a scourge on Godora for a long time. Countless citizens have lost their lives because of it. We will publicly judge this vicious criminal and give justice to all Godora citizens … I declare that the Dark-star organization is destroyed!"

Some of the Godora people in the crowd could not help but cheer when they heard this.

Brock, on the other hand, was stunned. He stared blankly at the dispirited Dark-star leader. His legs turned to jelly, and he almost knelt on the ground. His whole body trembled, and he could not believe what he was seeing.

He had been silently waiting for the Dark-star leader to contact him, waiting to persuade the leader not to deal with Black Star. However, he did not expect the leader, who had disappeared for a few years, to appear for the first time and become a captive of Black Star.

Then, what's the point of me hiding in the Black Star Corps?

All my work has been for nothing!!

It was as if Brock was struck by lightning. His mind was in a mess, and he was completely stunned.

All the galactic reporters were energized. Godora's highest leader had personally announced the complete destruction of the Dark-star organization, which meant that Godora had finally eradicated its archenemy. This was indeed a big news.

However, they did not expect that this was just an appetizer. The more shocking part was yet to come.

"It was not an accident that I met the Dark-star leader this time. Everyone, please take a look." Han Xiao opened his mouth, and the nanoparticles turned into a small floating ball in his palm, forming a projection in the air.

Everyone looked over. It was the recording of the battle between Han Xiao and the Dark-star leader.

The mechanical suit's tactical analyzer recorded the battle process. Han Xiao felt that the effect of the video was better than words, so he played the recording directly.

Everyone looked shocked when they saw the Dark-star leader summon the EsGod doppelganger. This time, Han Xiao added, "According to the data, the person the Dark-star leader summoned is the doppelganger of the Lord of Fallen Ark."

The Fallen Ark!

Every Star Field knew of the notoriety of this organization. Dark-star was actually related to this infamous organization?

Everyone was shocked.

The reporters suddenly realized this and looked at Han Xiao with dazed expressions.

Black Star was assassinated, but he was standing there perfectly fine. Did this not mean that Black Star could survive in the hands of a Beyond Grade A?

After understanding this, the entire place became so silent that one could hear a pin drop. Countless shocked and shocked gazes focused on Han Xiao.

Although Han Xiao's reputation as a Beyond Grade A seed had been circulating in the Shattered Star Ring for the past few years, everyone knew that he was not a true Beyond Grade A, and there was a huge gap between him and the Tyrant, Dragon Emperor, and other Beyond Grade As.

The various organizations only acknowledged Black Star's dominance in the Calamity Grade and his future potential. No one felt that Black Star could be compared to these true Beyond Grade As.

However, Han Xiao had released a video of him fighting a Beyond Grade A, and he had even survived!

The reporters present trembled in excitement and hurriedly recorded the video Han Xiao released. The eyes of the Black Star members who had come to join in the fun also sparkled. The stronger their leader was, the brighter their future would be.

Han Xiao did not release the entire video, leaving out the wormhole at the end. He also edited out a portion of it and did not reveal any of his key abilities. However, this was enough to increase his reputation.

Seeing the excitement on the faces of the reporters, Han Xiaoxin knew that he had to strike while the iron was hot, so he gave the Purple Crystal emissary a look.

The Purple Crystal emissary understood, stepped forward, and said loudly, "According to our investigation, we discovered that the Dark-star leader did not act alone. There was someone behind him. After our investigation, we discovered that Klent had secret dealings with Dark-star a long time ago. We suspect that Klent might be secretly supporting Dark-star's actions and disrupting the security of the Colton Star Cluster. Therefore, on behalf of Purple Crystal, I announce that we will be joining forces with Godora to interrogate the Dark-star leader!"

As soon as this was said, the entire place was in an uproar!

The galactic reporters present were no longer excited but completely stunned. This last piece of news was much more explosive than the previous two!

If what Purple Crystal said was true, it meant that Klent had always been funding Dark-star to destroy civilizations. Furthermore, the suspicion of being connected to the Fallen Ark would naturally fall on Klent!

This was a taboo for the three Universal Civilizations!

The capture of the Dark-star leader actually involved such a huge inside story!

At this moment, these reporters knew that this report would definitely cause a sensation in the entire Star Field!
